description:
The /tree overlay should have a search input field labeled "Type to search:" that filters tree entries as the user types.

**OBSERVED (Elixir):**
- No search input field exists

**EXPECTED (Node.js):**
After the hints row, there's a "Type to search:" label/text input that filters entries in real-time as the user types.

**Where to fix:**
- TreeSelector component needs a filter_text field and typing handling
- handle_key/2 needs to intercept character keys and build a filter
- render/2 needs to show the search prompt and current filter text
- Look at SessionSelector's filter functionality for reference implementation
- This ticket is blocked by opi-umz.1 (header must come first)
title: opi-277.3: /tree missing search input field
